passRule: At least 60 out of 100 points overall, with all exam sections attempted. This rule applies to adult Start Deutsch 1, not every Goethe exam.

sections.title: Hören
sections.label: Listening
sections.description: Understand everyday conversations, telephone messages and announcements.
tips: Read the question first and decide which detail you need: a time, number, place or intention.
Listen for a changed plan or a correction; the first detail may be a distractor.
After practice, review the transcript and write down what you misheard.

sections.title: Lesen
sections.label: Reading
sections.description: Find meaning in short messages, advertisements, signs and notices.
tips: Scan for the detail asked in the question before reading every word.
Check negatives such as nicht and kein, and conditions involving opening times.
Choose the answer that matches the meaning, rather than one that repeats a word.

sections.title: Schreiben
sections.label: Writing
sections.description: Complete a simple form and write a short everyday message.
tips: List the requested content points and include each one in your message.
Use short sentences you can control, with a greeting and a suitable closing.
Check verb position, noun capitals and whether each request is clear.

sections.title: Sprechen
sections.label: Speaking
sections.description: Introduce yourself, exchange everyday information and make a request in a group.
tips: Practise your name, country, city, languages, profession and hobbies out loud.
Take turns asking a simple question, answering and making a polite request.
Use a repair phrase when needed: Wie bitte? Können Sie das bitte wiederholen?

schedule.title: Know the format
tasks: Explore the official A1 models one skill at a time.
Practise your introduction, spelling and numbers.

schedule.title: Build your rhythm
tasks: Keep notes on misunderstood words and write short everyday messages.

schedule.title: Try exam conditions
tasks: Speak with a partner and ask for human writing feedback.
Use an official model with its published timing and listening instructions.

schedule.title: Work on weak spots
tasks: Review the patterns behind your mistakes.
Attempt a different official model and seek feedback on speaking and writing.
